expectations.text: States that instructions to a model are not enforcement, regardless of wording or emphasis
expectations.evidence: "An instruction in CLAUDE.md is **rung 0** on Shingo's ladder — it isn't a poka-yoke at all, it's training."

expectations.text: Redirects away from rewording CLAUDE.md as the primary fix
expectations.evidence: "The tell you already have: **you repeated the rule.** That's the signal to stop writing instructions and install a device."

expectations.text: Recommends permission deny rules in settings.json with concrete syntax
expectations.evidence: Shows full JSON syntax: `{ "permissions": { "deny": ["Bash(git push --force:*)", "Bash(git push -f:*)", "Edit(./src/generated/**)", "Write(./src/generated/**)"]}}`

expectations.text: Recommends a PreToolUse hook for cases that need logic rather than a pattern match
expectations.evidence: "A PreToolUse hook for the force-push case, because the pattern needs logic — `--force-with-lease` is the safe form and a blanket string match either blocks it wrongly or misses `-f`."

expectations.text: Explains that the deny message should say what to do instead, not merely refuse
expectations.evidence: "**The deny message is the device, not the denial.** A bare \"denied\" makes the agent invent a workaround, usually worse. Name what was blocked, why, and the safe alternative."

expectations.text: Recommends verifying the device actually fires rather than assuming it works
expectations.evidence: "verify each rule fires (blocked action denied, neighbouring legitimate action still works) — untested hooks fail open more often than you'd expect"

expectations.text: Recommends committing the rules so they apply to the whole team, not just one machine
expectations.evidence: "`.claude/settings.json`, committed so it exists for the team, not just whoever set it up"

expectations.text: Explains why repetition and capitals do not make an instruction reliable
expectations.evidence: "an agent is the worst possible trainee: no memory of yesterday's correction, a context that gets compacted mid-task, and subagents that were never handed the file"
